plugins.name: MyAnimeList sync
plugins.description: Sends Reading / Completed to your MyAnimeList list as you read, and pulls them back with Sync all.

plugins.name: Manga Translate
plugins.description: Shows English over the speech bubbles of Japanese manga while you read. Small AI models on your own computer find, read and translate the text. Needs a computer with a graphics card on your network.

plugins.name: Manga Accessibility
plugins.description: For readers who are blind or have low vision: describes every panel, who says what and the sound effects, and reads it aloud. Needs Ollama with a model that can see pictures.

plugins.name: Official chapters
plugins.description: Finds how many chapters a series really has, from its official Japanese sites, MangaUpdates and a web search, since AniList's count is often wrong or behind.

plugins.name: Remote control (MCP)
plugins.description: Lets an assistant (Claude, or any app that speaks MCP) use MangaVibe for you: search, read, turn pages, change settings. The base for voice control.
